items.title: Married at First Sight UK cancelled after BBC revealed rape allegations
items.summary: Channel 4 will reinvest the show's budget in "distinctive new programming" and said sorry again to the women involved.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo retires from international football
items.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has announced his retirement from international football.

items.title: New £200m fleet of publicly funded trains in Wales barely used after three years
items.summary: The final piece in a £2bn rail project is late, with less than half of the trains tested.

items.title: Channel 4 axes Married At First Sight UK after review
items.summary: Married At First Sight UK will not return to Channel 4 following an external review launched in the wake of sexual misconduct allegations, the broadcaster has announced.

items.title: Pound rises to its highest level since the Brexit referendum
items.summary: Pound reaches highest level against a basket of currencies since the Brexit referendum a decade ago.

items.title: 'Wild west' e-bike parking targeted
items.summary: The government is seeking to end "wild west" e-bike parking and crack down on antisocial behaviour, such as riding on pavements.
